subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lead-in: transport then and now; core words; conventional vs solar-powered planes
outcomes: Explain the point of a cartoon about congestion on land and in the sky
Match the Theme 4 core words with their meanings
Compare a petroleum-fuelled plane with a solar-powered plane

tf.s: Congestion means vehicles crowding together so they can't move.
tf.why: Traffic jams are an example of congestion.

tf.s: The cartoon shows that congestion happens only on roads, never in the sky.
tf.why: The cartoon shows congestion on land and in the skies.

tf.s: Road rage is violent and angry behaviour by drivers towards other drivers.
tf.why: Road rage is dangerous anger on the road.

tf.s: A network is a system of lines connected to each other.
tf.why: Roads and flight routes can form a network.

tf.s: Petroleum-based fuel produces carbon dioxide emissions that contribute to global warming.
Petroleum fuel will never run out.
tf.why: Petroleum fuel will run out one day.

tf.s: A solar-powered plane uses energy from the sun.
Calculators cannot be powered by solar energy.
tf.why: Many calculators, cars and boats can use solar power.

tf.s: 'Stressful' describes something that makes you feel relaxed and calm.
tf.why: Stressful things make you feel worried or tense.

tf.s: Biofuels are fuels made from plant or animal materials.
tf.why: Yes, biofuels come from living materials such as plants.

boxes.why: Carbon dioxide emissions contribute to global warming.

mcq.why: Congestion is a traffic problem of too many vehicles.

mcq.q: What are the problems of petroleum-based fuel?
o: It produces carbon dioxide, adds to global warming and will run out
It is free and never runs out
mcq.why: These are the problems discussed in the lesson.

mcq.q: Which things can be powered by solar energy?
mcq.why: Solar energy can power many machines.

o: Violent and angry behaviour by drivers towards other drivers
mcq.why: Road rage is angry, dangerous driving behaviour.

mcq.q: A driver shouts and hits his horn angrily at another car in a traffic jam. Which core word describes his behaviour?
mcq.why: Angry behaviour towards other drivers is road rage.

mcq.q: Complete: '___ is a system of lines connected to each other.'
mcq.why: A network connects lines, like roads or routes.

mcq.q: A report says '60% of drivers are late because of traffic'. What kind of information is this?

mcq.q: What point does the cartoon make?
o: Congestion is now a problem in the sky as well as on the roads
Planes never fly near each other
mcq.why: The cartoon shows that air space is becoming crowded too.

mcq.q: Why might solar-powered planes be better for the environment than petroleum-fuelled planes?
o: They do not produce carbon dioxide from burning fuel
mcq.why: Sunlight is clean energy and does not run out.

mcq.q: Why is congestion in the sky a serious problem?
o: Crowded air space makes flying more stressful and harder for air traffic control
It makes the sky more colourful
It has no effect on anyone
mcq.why: More planes in the sky need more careful control.
